title: Demand rising, seen at one price

steps.title: Start with one price
steps.say: Forget the shifting curve for a moment. Pick one price, P1, and look only at that horizontal line.

steps.title: Sales before
steps.say: At price P1, buyers want Q1 units. That is the point E on the old demand curve D1.

steps.title: More buyers
steps.say: Demand rises, so at the same price P1 more buyers want the product. The quantity sold moves right, from Q1 to Q2.

steps.title: Price follows
steps.say: Sellers now have more buyers than they can serve at P1, so the price is pushed up until the market settles at a higher price.
